name: July
objective: Protect monsoon attendance and late cancels; get people onto a membership before The Amazing Race 2.0 starts on 1 Aug.
strategy:
Rain Check.

Commercial job: Protect monsoon attendance and late cancels; get people onto a membership before The Amazing Race 2.0 starts on 1 Aug.

Newcomer: Kickstart 21: Race Ready (“21 days that end on the Amazing Race start line.”). Gives July a goal and a date; graduation lands on race day one.

Winback: Warm-Up Lap (“Get race-fit before the gun goes on 1 August. 20% off.”). An event with a date plus a real discount brings lapsed clients back before the race.

Renewal: Midyear Report Card (“Your half-year in numbers, and a better price to keep going.”). A mid-year 'Wrapped' moves members to the product that fits how they actually train, and longer plans protect the monsoon months.

Renewal: Rain Check Renewal (“Monsoon happens. 10% off, and your late cancels are forgiven.”). Monsoon late cancels are why July renewers feel they 'wasted' a month; this removes the grievance.
notes:
Moment: Monsoon Streak leaderboard; race registrations open Thu 15 Jul.
Build: new clients 42 buyers × ₹12,000 = ₹5.0L; reactivation 36 × ₹11,468 = ₹4.1L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹3.0L; renewals ₹19.3L. First visits needed 140 vs 121 last year (1.16×); CRM leads needed 280 vs 155 last year.
